purpose: Create price rules that protect margin across US and UK launch markets before products are imported.

definitions.landed_cost: The real estimated cost to get a product to the customer, including product cost, supplier shipping, duties, import taxes where relevant, payment fees, return buffer, and packaging or handling assumptions.
definitions.gross_margin: The percentage of the selling price left after product and fulfilment cost before overhead and advertising.
definitions.price_floor: The lowest visible competitor price customers can easily compare against.

starting_margin_policy.rule_summary: A product below 40 percent estimated gross margin should be rejected or repositioned unless there is a clear strategic reason.

currency_policy.rule_summary: GBP prices should be approved as market prices, not blind currency conversions.
currency_policy.why: UK VAT, duties, shipping costs, competitor prices, and customer expectations can differ from the US.

price_rounding.US: Use customer-friendly endings such as .99 only after margin check.
price_rounding.GB: Use customer-friendly endings such as .99 only after margin check.
